intent: Record as reviewed further rules the activity Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context activity lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The activity service itself refuses a page limit below 1 or above 100, whatever its caller checked.
A cursor naming a priority rank outside 0 to 3 is refused as invalid, so a forged cursor cannot reach a rank the feed does not have.
A cursor without a kind or without a source id is refused as invalid.
An item whose classification the feed does not know ranks below needs-attention, in-progress and recent items.
A page the activity service serves says it is complete and names all contracted sources, even when it holds no items.
When any activity source cannot be read, the request answers 503 with complete=false, the failed sources and no items.
